requirements.title: Working project foundation
requirements.evidence: Working source and build (60); authored program logic (35); meaningful tests (20); run guide and evidence map (20); individual explanation (15).

requirements.title: Save and restore progress
requirements.evidence: Save meaningful state; close and reopen the program; demonstrate correct restoration and invalid-file handling.

requirements.title: Accessible controls and interface
requirements.evidence: Demonstrate keyboard access, readable contrast, clear feedback and one user-tested accessibility improvement.

requirements.title: External playtest and revision
requirements.evidence: Use consented feedback from at least three testers; document problems, fixes and retest evidence.

requirements.title: Project T-shirt design + mockup
requirements.evidence: Create an original graphic connected to your project in Canva or another design tool. Submit the editable source or export, a readable PNG and a shirt mockup, plus a short design explanation. No purchase or paid account is required.

requirements.title: Project logo or title treatment
requirements.evidence: Design a project-specific logo or title mark. Include the editable source, a clean export, one in-context use and a short explanation. Use a separate artifact from the T-shirt graphic.

requirements.title: Illustrated player or user quick start
requirements.evidence: Create a one-page illustrated controls or getting-started card for your actual project. Include the source/export and document one person trying its instructions. This is distinct from the required run guide.

requirements.title: Branching story or mission state
requirements.evidence: Demonstrate at least two meaningful outcomes, their conditions and a state-transition test.

requirements.title: Modular architecture
requirements.evidence: Show a module/class diagram, clear responsibilities and a change made without rewriting unrelated systems.

requirements.title: Automated regression tests
requirements.evidence: Run meaningful normal, boundary and failure tests. Show a defect the suite detects.

requirements.title: Settings that persist
requirements.evidence: Provide useful settings, validate changes, save them and demonstrate restoration. This must extend beyond the same progress data.

requirements.title: Public release on an approved platform
requirements.evidence: Publish an accessible working build, versioned release notes and installation/run instructions on Steam or an approved equivalent. Platform acceptance alone earns no points.

requirements.title: Original product trailer and media kit
requirements.evidence: Show actual product footage, clear captions and an accurate short pitch. Include source/asset credits.

requirements.title: Reusable dialogue or interaction system
requirements.evidence: Use data-driven interactions in more than one situation; show how new content can be added.
